## Checks

- [ ] change is scoped and reviewable

- [ ] API changes are reflected in `openapi/openapi.json` and `docs/api.md`

- [ ] `.env.example` matches `docs/operations.md`
- [ ] significant decisions have an ADR
- [ ] no secret or personal data was added unintentionally
- [ ] no disallowed payment, permanentka, capacity-count or waitlist behavior was introduced
